step1.title: Registered Area
step1.description: This is information about the planting area for all plan details you have registered. Unit is measured in hectares (ha).

step2.title: Select Plan Detail
step2.description: Select the plan detail you want to register to sell.

step3.title: Enter Detail Information
step3.description: Fill in complete information about yield, price and harvest time

step4.title: Submit Registration
step4.description: Review the information and submit registration for business review

importantNotes.title: Important Notes
items: Only farmers can register to join plans
Registration information will be reviewed by businesses

contactInfo.title: Contact Information
contactInfo.description: If you encounter issues or need support, please contact us.

approve.title: Confirm Approve Registration Detail
approve.description: Are you sure you want to approve this {{coffeeType}} registration detail? After approval, the farmer will be notified and you can proceed with next steps. You can create a commitment with them to unlock the crop season reporting feature for farmers.

reject.title: Reject Registration Detail
reject.description: Are you sure you want to reject this {{coffeeType}} registration detail? After rejection, you cannot approve this detail again, other details of this registration will not be affected by this action.
